body.name: observed-filtration posterior and action-history factor
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal F_{t-1}^{\mathrm{obs}}:=\sigma(A_1,Y_1,\ldots,A_{t-1},Y_{t-1})\), \(\ell_t:=\min\{Q,t-1\}\), \(q_t^v:=\Pr_v(J_t=Q\mid\mathcal F_{t-1}^{\mathrm{obs}})\), and \(a_t^{(Q)}:=L^{-(Q-\ell_t)}\prod_{j=t-\ell_t}^{t-1}\mathbf 1\{A_j=1\}\), with an empty product equal to one.
